Params: {1: '1', 2: 'Ascendant John Doe', 3: 'Impossible... This level of power... How?', 4: '1'}
{3: "With hope of victory extinguished, John Doe is consumed by a furious fire. A primal terror grips him as he beholds Teddy's new frame; this was an impossibility, a flaw in his grand blueprint."}
{3: 'Like that [exception]. A singular anomaly. He has merely harnessed a sliver of its power, yet achieved so much already.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Could the miracle she represents be proof that she has earned the right to "become the exception"?'}
{3: "Teddy studies the Ascendant with fresh eyes. It wasn't that he wouldn't absorb the power; he simply couldn't."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Ascendant John Doe', 3: 'How did you uncover [its] secret...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Because I have something you never had, and never will.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ascendant John Doe', 3: 'What could you possibly know about me?!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The fight has left him, but not his defiance.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Ascendant John Doe', 3: 'Power is the only truth... No matter the cost!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ascendant John Doe', 3: 'Why are you people always the special ones?! Why do you get to have EVERYTHING?!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'He lashes out at Teddy, but the gesture is feeble, the last spark of a dying fire.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Ascendant John Doe', 3: "You've actually become a potential solution... A statistical probability, if not a certainty.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ascendant John Doe', 3: 'Tell me, have you truly reached the throne, or are you just a convincing imitation?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ascendant John Doe', 3: "It doesn't matter... Until the very end, everyone is just guessing about destiny.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ascendant John Doe', 3: 'Perhaps when all is revealed, you will be exposed as a fragile counterfeit.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ascendant John Doe', 3: 'You will become the very falsehood you scorn.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ascendant John Doe', 3: "There's plenty of time... I will be waiting for that day.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ascendant John Doe', 3: 'The wind does not falter... I shall return...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'With his final threat hanging in the air, the Ascendant turns to flee. He shows no attachment, not even a final glance toward Moineau, as his form gradually unravels into nothingness.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Though severely wounded, Moineau remains standing before Teddy, silent.'}
